name: list_timesheet_entries
title: GET_TimeSheetEntryCollection
description: Reads data for all workforce’s timesheet entries. It retrieves information about the time recording made by each workforce’s on a particular task and on a particular day. It also includes information such as recorded hours on a task, timesheet note, timesheet status and so on.

name: create_timesheet_entry
title: POST_TimeSheetEntryCollection
description: Creates, updates, or deletes workforce timesheet entry based on the data provided in payload. You can set the type of operation you would like to perform on timesheet entry based on the ‘TimeSheetOperation’ parameter (Create(‘C’),Update(‘U’) and Delete(‘D’)).
